_about: Round 141b (Robert, 2026-10-17: 'more variety of beast companions, they should have more function and use, and human companions that can maybe end up a party member'). BEASTS: every tameable animal has a ROLE (tracker, forager, digger, hunter, healer, guardian, striker, lantern, scholar, courier, charmer, lucky): a small passive gift that grows with its bond (like any familiar's), and a DEED you can ask of it (a buff, a heal, or a few of its finds) on a cooldown. 26 new tameable species fill floors 2-47 and wander the floors (scripts/systems/Menagerie.gd places 0-2 per floor). HUMANS: ten WAYFARERS wait in the towns. Anyone can take them on without the long friendship the villagers want; each has a trade, a gift while they travel with you, a deed, and TRUST that grows as you fight, descend and use their deed together. Reach their oath floor with trust 60 and they ask to SWEAR: a sworn companion adds a second gift for good, can always be called back from any town, and their deed recovers faster. Numbers here; nothing else holds them.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.desc: Nose to the ground. Sharpens your senses so hidden things show from further off.

deed.name: Pick up the trail
deed.desc: For two minutes your senses reach much further.

forager.name: Forager
forager.desc: Knows what grows where. Plants and roots come to hand more often.

deed.name: Forage
deed.desc: It roots about and comes back with something useful (a few of its finds).

digger.name: Digger
digger.desc: Digs where ore sleeps. Rock gives a little more.

deed.name: Dig
deed.desc: It tears up the ground and comes back with ore and stone (a few of its finds).

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.desc: Brings down small game and drags it back. Never lets you go hungry.

deed.name: Run down game
deed.desc: It's gone a minute, then drops meat and hide at your feet.

healer.name: Healer
healer.desc: Licks wounds, steadies breath. A little life comes back with every kill.

deed.name: Tend your wounds
deed.desc: Restores a third of your life.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.desc: Plants itself between you and trouble. Blows land a little softer.

deed.name: Stand guard
deed.desc: For 45 seconds you take a good deal less damage.

striker.name: Striker
striker.desc: Bites first and hardest. Your own blows carry a little of its fury.

deed.name: Savage them
deed.desc: For 30 seconds you hit harder and crit more.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.desc: Gives off a soft light. You see further in the dark.

deed.name: Glow bright
deed.desc: For five minutes the dark gives way around you.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.desc: Quiet, watchful, unnervingly wise. Insight comes a little easier.

deed.name: Share a thought
deed.desc: For ten minutes insight and sitting come faster.

courier.name: Courier
courier.desc: Quick on its feet and quicker to move you along.

deed.name: Run ahead
deed.desc: For 90 seconds you move faster and slip blows more easily.

charmer.name: Charmer
charmer.desc: People and beasts warm to what it's with. Bonds grow a little faster.

deed.name: Make friends
deed.desc: For ten minutes bonds with anyone you talk to grow much faster.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.desc: Things turn up around it. Drops fall a little kinder.

deed.name: Turn the luck
deed.desc: For two minutes drops are much likelier.

warden.name: Warden
warden.desc: Holds a quiet line. Wounds knit a little between blows.

deed.name: Hold the line
deed.desc: For ninety seconds you mend and shrug off blows.

ember.name: Ember
ember.desc: Leaves a little fire in every blow.

deed.name: Fan the flame
deed.desc: Your strikes burn hotter for a minute and a half.

hoarder.name: Hoarder
hoarder.desc: Pockets what others leave. Less is lost when you fall.

deed.name: Dig up a cache
deed.desc: It comes back with silver and a few odds and ends.

brewer.name: Brewer
brewer.desc: Knows which roots steep into what. Kills leave you steadier.

deed.name: Steep a draught
deed.desc: It brings back herbs and a ready qi pill.

fury.name: Fury
fury.desc: Bristles when you are hurt, and so do you.

deed.name: Howl
deed.desc: A wild minute: you hit harder and crit more, the more it hurts.

mystic.name: Mystic
mystic.desc: Hums at the edge of hearing. Qi and stillness come easier.

deed.name: Sing you still
deed.desc: Meditation and qi run deeper for two minutes.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.desc: Watches your back and your timing.

deed.name: Call the beat
deed.desc: Parries and rolls land more forgivingly for a minute.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.desc: Eyes like a drawn string. Shots fly truer.

deed.name: Steady your aim
deed.desc: Your ranged blows hit harder for a minute.

wayfarers.name: Marin Ashgrove
wayfarers.persona: Marin Ashgrove, a field medic who walked out of a war nobody remembers. Gentle hands, dry humour, always counting bandages. Wants to stop being needed for wounds and be needed for something else.
wayfarers.line: Sit down, you're favouring that leg. No, don't argue. I've set worse with less.

deed.name: Bind your wounds
deed.desc: Restores half your life.

oath.text: I told myself I'd never follow anyone again. Then you carried a stranger out of the dark. Let me swear to you.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Marin presses two fingers to your wrist, as if counting a pulse, and says the words she never said to the army. She is yours until the road ends.

wayfarers.name: Dorn Quill
wayfarers.persona: Dorn Quill, a ranger with a scarred bow-arm and an eye for what doesn't belong. Laconic. Prefers tracks to words. Misses a valley that burned.
wayfarers.line: Three hares, a fox and one man who thinks he's quiet. He's behind that wall.

deed.name: Read the ground
deed.desc: For two minutes you see everything hidden within a long reach.

oath.text: You keep going back for the ones I'd have left. I'll walk behind you from now on, if you'll have me.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Dorn lays an arrow in your palm. 'That one's yours. The rest are mine to spend on whatever tries to hurt you.'

wayfarers.name: Hesk the Younger
wayfarers.persona: Hesk the Younger, a shield-bearer from a line of shield-bearers, last of them. Earnest, a little pompous, secretly afraid of being the one who fails. Tends his dead father's shield.
wayfarers.line: If it's coming for you, it will have to come through me. I practised the line. How did it sound?

deed.name: Raise the shield
deed.desc: For 45 seconds you take much less damage.

oath.text: My father said a shield is only a shield once it has someone to stand in front of. I have found mine.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Hesk drives his father's shield into the ground and kneels behind it. 'Ward of the house, as long as the house stands.'

wayfarers.name: Tamsin Reed
wayfarers.persona: Tamsin Reed, who speaks to animals more easily than to people and knows it. Quick laugh, muddy boots, a crow on her shoulder that isn't hers. Believes every beast chose its person.
wayfarers.line: That hare behind you is the third one to follow you today. Do you feed them, or is it your face?

deed.name: Sing to the beasts
deed.desc: Your beasts grow close faster, and the bond with them deepens at once (+12).

oath.text: The animals have been telling me for weeks that you're one of the good ones. I trust them more than I trust me. Take me.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Tamsin whistles a long, odd note and every beast of yours looks up. 'There. They know I'm with you now. So do I.'

wayfarers.name: Lio Verrane
wayfarers.persona: Lio Verrane, a duellist who stopped winning on purpose and found it made him better. Charming, fast, fond of a dramatic flourish he pretends is accidental.
wayfarers.line: I've lost eleven duels and learned from every one. You look like the twelfth. I'd rather travel with you than fight you, if it's all the same.

deed.name: Open a line
deed.desc: For 30 seconds you crit far more often.

oath.text: Fighting you would be a waste of a good friend. Let me spend my blade on whoever deserves it instead.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Lio salutes with a flourish and, for once, it isn't an accident. 'My blade, my word. In that order.'

wayfarers.name: Sister Wen
wayfarers.persona: Sister Wen, a monk who left her monastery on purpose. Serene on the surface, curious underneath, keeps asking 'but why' until it hurts. Collects other people's meditation methods.
wayfarers.line: You sit like someone who is trying. Sit like someone who is listening, and see what changes.

deed.name: Breathe together
deed.desc: For ten minutes sitting is faster and insight comes easier.

oath.text: I left to find a teacher who would let me argue. You argue back. I'd like to stay.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Wen bows lower than a monk should to anyone, then grins. 'Questions for the road. Yours first.'

wayfarers.name: Brask Orren
wayfarers.persona: Brask Orren, a smith who carries a portable anvil on his back and refuses to explain why. Booming laugh, burned eyebrows, deeply offended by badly balanced swords.
wayfarers.line: That edge is a crime. Hand it over, and I'll tell you everything that's wrong with it. It will take a while.

deed.name: True the edge
deed.desc: For ten minutes your crafting comes out better.

oath.text: Every smith wants one customer who uses the work. Hold on to me. I intend to see what you do with it.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Brask sets his anvil down for the first time in years and strikes it once. 'That note's yours. Mine. Ours. Let's go.'

wayfarers.name: Vey Calder
wayfarers.persona: Vey Calder, a fixer who knows a price for everything and a name for everyone. Smooth, observant, generous in ways he'd deny. Collects debts of gratitude, not gold.
wayfarers.line: Everyone in this pagoda owes someone. Tell me who you want to be owed by and I'll see what can be arranged.

deed.name: Call in a favour
deed.desc: For two minutes drops are much likelier and people warm to you.

oath.text: I have never owed anyone before you. It feels strange. Let me be in your debt for good.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Vey tears up a very long list and lets the pieces fall. 'Debts cleared. The only one left is the one I owe you.'

wayfarers.name: Pell Ardent
wayfarers.persona: Pell Ardent, a tinker whose own swarm has opinions. Jittery, brilliant, apologises to machines. Has never once finished a sentence before a better one occurred to her.
wayfarers.line: Oh! You carry a swarm. May I -- no, of course, sorry, can I just listen to it? It hums in a lovely key.

deed.name: Tune the swarm
deed.desc: For ten minutes your swarm works faster.

oath.text: I have tuned a thousand swarms and never one that wanted to be tuned. Yours does. I'd like to see where it goes.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Pell hums the swarm's note back to it and, for once, doesn't apologise. 'We're one team now. All of us.'

wayfarers.name: Isolde Kern
wayfarers.persona: Isolde Kern, a marksman who has not missed since the day she decided to. Formal, precise, quietly lonely. Keeps a notebook of every shot she has taken and the wind that day.
wayfarers.line: Forty-one paces, wind from the left, a thing in the rafters that thinks I haven't seen it. Do you want it gone?

deed.name: Mark the target
deed.desc: For 30 seconds your ranged strikes hit much harder.

oath.text: You have never once told me where to stand. I would like to choose to stand beside you.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Isolde closes her notebook and hands it to you. 'Last page is blank. Write what you like. I'll take the shot.'

wayfarers.name: Odalys Wren
wayfarers.persona: Odalys Wren, a hedge witch who sells charms she doesn't believe in and cures she does. Talks to the plants first and people second.
wayfarers.line: The nettles say you're coming down with something. Or in for something.

deed.name: Brew a poultice
deed.desc: Restores a third of your life.

oath.text: I never meant to leave the hedge. But you walk like someone who'll need a witch before the end.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Odalys ties a sprig of rue to your sleeve. 'There. Now it's binding.'

wayfarers.name: Tobiah Reeve
wayfarers.persona: Tobiah Reeve, thirty years guarding other people's wagons. Hates surprises, loves tea, never sits with his back to a door.
wayfarers.line: Quiet road is a lying road. Stay sharp.

deed.name: Circle the wagons
deed.desc: For a minute you take far less harm.

oath.text: Never took an oath to a customer. You're not a customer anymore.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Tobiah shakes your hand once, firmly. 'Back to the door, then. Yours.'

wayfarers.name: Zhu Ling
wayfarers.persona: Zhu Ling, a scribe who copies the walls of every ruin and sells the copies to people who'll never visit. Carries too many brushes.
wayfarers.line: Hold still. No, the other way. You're in my light.

deed.name: Read the walls
deed.desc: For two minutes insight comes faster.

oath.text: I have copied a thousand walls. I would like to be written into one of yours.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Zhu Ling inks a small mark on your wrist. 'Witnessed.'

wayfarers.name: Kell Varga
wayfarers.persona: Kell Varga, who collected debts for a guild that no longer exists and kept collecting out of habit. Blunt, fair, oddly sentimental about stray dogs.
wayfarers.line: Everyone owes something. Let's see what you do with yours.

deed.name: Collect
deed.desc: For a minute your blows land heavier.

oath.text: The ledger's closed. You never asked me for anything, which is why I'm offering.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Kell tears a page from his ledger and gives it to you, blank. 'No debts between us.'

wayfarers.name: Neve Aldous
wayfarers.persona: Neve Aldous, who fishes through the ice of lakes that shouldn't freeze. Patient to a fault, bad at small talk, good at silence.
wayfarers.line: Shh. Something's biting.

deed.name: Cast a line
deed.desc: She comes back with meat, hide and something strange.

oath.text: I wait for the catch that's worth keeping. I think that's you.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Neve hands you a bone hook on a cord. 'Don't lose it. Don't let go of it either.'

wayfarers.name: Rhosyn Dale
wayfarers.persona: Rhosyn Dale, a fairground fire-eater who learned the trick was real. Showy, brave, a little terrified of what she can do.
wayfarers.line: Stand back. Or don't. It's a good show either way.

deed.name: Breathe fire
deed.desc: Your strikes burn for ninety seconds.

oath.text: I've lit up for a thousand crowds. Let me burn for one person who sees me.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Rhosyn kisses a spark off her thumb and lets it die on yours. 'Mine. Yours. Whatever.'

wayfarers.name: Anselm Thorne
wayfarers.persona: Anselm Thorne, who rang the bell of a drowned town until the tide took the tower. Slow-spoken, steady, hears the hour in everything.
wayfarers.line: Time. It's always time for something.

deed.name: Ring the hour
deed.desc: A minute of forgiving timing and sure feet.

oath.text: The bell is gone. I'd like to keep something ringing.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Anselm taps a slow count on your shoulder. 'That is the time we keep.'

wayfarers.name: Saffi Okoro
wayfarers.persona: Saffi Okoro, a seed-trader who smuggles plants across places they're banned. Cheerful, dishonest only about prices.
wayfarers.line: I've got something you can't buy here. Which is why it costs double.

deed.name: Scatter seed
deed.desc: She comes back with herbs and a pill.

oath.text: I plant things and walk away. You're the first thing I want to come back to.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Saffi presses a seed into your palm. 'If it grows, we're even. If not, you owe me.'

wayfarers.name: Barrow Quill
wayfarers.persona: Barrow Quill, who keeps the dead company so nobody else has to. Gentle, grim, strangely good with the living.
wayfarers.line: They don't mind visitors. Ask them anything.

deed.name: Stand vigil
deed.desc: A minute and a half of mending and warding.

oath.text: The dead have all the company they need. I'd like to keep the living for a change.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Barrow sets a pebble on your palm. 'One for each who made it. Keep going.'

wayfarers.name: Ysolde Kane
wayfarers.persona: Ysolde Kane, who shot messages between mountain towns until the winds changed. Proud, precise, bad at losing.
wayfarers.line: One arrow. One answer. Try not to flinch.

deed.name: Loose a volley
deed.desc: Your ranged blows hit harder for a minute.

oath.text: I only follow what I can't out-shoot. So far that's you.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Ysolde gives you a fletched shaft. 'Aim true. I'll cover the left.'

wayfarers.name: Momo Ha
wayfarers.persona: Momo Ha, who apprentices to a tea spirit that mostly sulks. Dreamy, exact, always steeping something.
wayfarers.line: Is it too hot? It's meant to be too hot.

deed.name: Pour a cup
deed.desc: Meditation and qi run deeper for two minutes.

oath.text: The spirit says go. For once I agree with it.

wayfarers.sworn_text: Momo sets a cup of nothing in your hands. It is warm. 'That's us.'
